reference.public_release: Merlin 3.0.0 checkpoint, public on Hugging Face (halt95/Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-W4A16-Merlin, pinned revision a0c5c92c01ac87bee8fd94299897970bc83072bf); tested on the reference host per the 2026-10-20 bench card (models/nemotron-super-vl/benchmarks/2026-10-20)

profiles.title: Nemotron Super VL 120B-A12B (W4A16 + INT4 MTP head) on 4 x RTX 3090 24 GB (TP2 x PP2 + EP, RecoverSSM)

capacity.basis: The shipped 1M default (max_model_len 1,048,576; RecoverSSM + MTP3, block 64, 2.50 GiB pin per card) allocates a 1,856,367-token hybrid pool, logged by the 1M-default reference-host runs (2026-10-21 and 2026-10-22). Residency-proven at 1M: an identical 1,048,052-token re-send was served with 1,047,936 tokens cached, 3.05 s to first token, 0 preemptions. fit_262k is measured (5 x 262K resident), not the pool ratio. 1,392,275 tokens was the pool at the same pin with max_model_len 262,144 (reference-host runs 2026-10-16, where the 3 x 131K load was the check); 131K residency is that pool's ratio, not a measured 10-stream load.

profiles.p2p: Required for the tested numbers: the launcher sets VLLM_SKIP_P2P_CHECK=1 NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS and the reference host runs full P2P. No non-P2P host has been run.
evidence: Reference-host runs 2026-10-16 (4 x RTX 3090, full P2P): RecoverSSM + MTP3 booted at the 2.50 GiB pin, pool 1,392,275 tokens (5.31 x 262K); 3 x 131K load passed. Stage-1 free memory under load 870 MiB at layer partition 46,42 (64 MiB at 44,44); stage 0 283 MiB on GPU 0 / 544 MiB on GPU 1 before the front-end CUDA-context fix. The 3.0.0 bench card has since run (next line).

Merlin 3.0.0 release bench card (2026-10-20, release wheel, 4 x RTX 3090 at 220 W, full P2P; models/nemotron-super-vl/benchmarks/2026-10-20): decode 97 / 101 / 91 tok/s at 4K / 131K / 262K (thinking on), 5 x 262K and 9 x 131K resident with 0 preemptions, 8 MP image correct (686 MiB lowest free), pool 1,392,275 at a 262K context; its agent, GSM8K and needle rows are from the pre-release build.
Supporting: the Merlin 3.0.0 pre-release bench run (2026-10-17, 4 x RTX 3090 at 220 W, full P2P): Super VL row PASS with no flags; GSM8K 195/200, needle 262K 23/23 and 131K 10/10, pool 1,392,275.

2026-10-21, max_model_len 1,048,576 (the 1M default): a 1,048,052-token needle found exactly (731 s to the answer), the 262K needle and the 8 MP image passed, 5 x 262K and 9 x 131K needle prompts sent at once all answered, minimum free 666 MiB (reference-host run).

2026-10-22, the 1M default (reference-host run): pool 1,856,367 tokens at the 2.50 GiB pin, as on 2026-10-21; an identical 1,048,052-token re-send was served with 1,047,936 tokens cached, 3.05 s to first token, 0 preemptions.
notes: Checkpoint: halt95/Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-W4A16-Merlin (W4A16 rtn-g128 routed experts, INT4 MTP head).
RecoverSSM is --use-replayssm with --mamba-backend triton on Model Runner V2; prefix caching runs with --mamba-cache-mode align and block / prefix-match unit 64.
Layer partition 46,42 (VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION) leaves both stages above the 512 MiB free floor in the reference-host runs once GPU 0's front-end CUDA context is gone; 44,44 left stage 1 with 64 MiB.
Images: the model's own processor resizes to at most 13,312 patches (about 3.4 MP); 8 MP and larger inputs are accepted and downscaled. There is no size cap to set in --mm-processor-kwargs.
The 2.50 GiB KV pin passed the 3.0.0 release bench card and the 2026-10-21/22 1M-default runs on the reference host.

profiles.title: Nemotron Super VL 120B-A12B (W4A16 + INT4 MTP head) on 4 x RTX 4090 24 GB (sm_89), TP2 x PP2 + EP, RecoverSSM, the svl-quad-3090 pin

launcher.note: no shim pins this row; merlin serve --profile svl-quad-sm89-24g (or tools/merlin/launch.py --profile) starts it

capacity.basis: Same per-card KV pin as svl-quad-3090, so the pool is that row's 262K-mode pool (1,392,275; the 1M default allocates 1,856,367 at this pin on the 3090 row) by construction; extra VRAM on the 32 and 48 GB classes is headroom, not a larger pool. evidence: 4 x RTX 4090, measured 2026-10-18: svl-quad-sm89-24g, P2P off, pool 1,392,275 tokens, needles 262K-32K 4/4 exact, coherence 3/3, 8 MP image correct.

4 x RTX 4090 on the release wheel, measured 2026-10-20: pool 1,392,275, needles 4/4 exact, 5 x 262K, 9 x 131K and 9 x 32K resident and exact, image pass (645 MiB minimum free). Both runs used the 262K context mode; the 1M default has not run on these cards. Testing: the runs above were on cloud-hosted hardware; kernel parity qualification is still to run.

launch.note: The Super VL family shape of tools/merlin/launch.py (the models/nemotron-super-vl/serve.sh argv). kv_cache_dtype_flag is the --kv-cache-dtype spelling the launcher passes (the profile's fp8_e4m3 is the engine's canonical name). max_model_len is the model's native 1,048,576 (the default); every row's pool holds one 1M session. merlin serve drops MAXLEN to 262,144 when a card's reduced pin leaves a pool under 1M.
